visualCharacteristics.purpose: Media grid of image and video tiles from an audi.com model gallery (images gallery, videos gallery); each tile links to its audi.com detail or video page
visualCharacteristics.image: 4:3 cropped photo, illustration, sketch or video poster
visualCharacteristics.extras: play indicator on tiles whose link points to a /videos/ page; the whole tile is clickable through the title link; no category tabs, no Load more, videos are not embedded

contentPattern.structure: one row per gallery item. cell 1: image (+ alt), a photo or the video poster; cell 2: richtext with the category label paragraph (Photos, Illustrations, Sketches, Footage, Animation, Trailer) and a paragraph with the title link to the audi.com detail page (/en/images/detail/...) or video page (/en/videos/video/...). Every part optional.
contentPattern.itemCount: first 8 images or first 4 videos per gallery (user decision)

reuseGuidance: Use for image/video gallery grids whose tiles link to a detail page; for teasers with date and description use cards-list, for purchasable model tiles use cards-model.
